count_semantics.catalog_reports: Known report names in the website catalog; this is not an evidence count.
count_semantics.historical_image_audit_universe: Images reviewed in the historical private audit; this is not a retained or release-safe count.
count_semantics.historically_evidenced_report_groups: Report groups that had at least one image in the historical private audit; this is not current safe coverage.
count_semantics.strict_schema_only_images_retained: Audited images safe for the isolated private candidate; this is an image count, not a report-group count.
count_semantics.operational_value_images_excluded: Historical images excluded because operational values were visible.
count_semantics.schema_only_image_report_groups_covered: Historically evidenced report groups with at least one retained strict schema-only image.
count_semantics.report_groups_pending_schema_only_image: Historically evidenced report groups that still lack a safe image.
count_semantics.pending_image_groups_with_verified_text_: Image-pending groups with a separately verified text-schema card; text cards do not count as screenshots.
count_semantics.pending_image_groups_still_text_pending: Image-pending groups that still lack a provenance-complete text schema.
count_semantics.verified_text_schema_fields: Fields emitted by the verified text-schema cards for the 27 text-covered groups.
count_semantics.text_cards_count_as_screenshots: Always false: text-schema cards add structural evidence but never image coverage.
count_semantics.public_website_screenshot_assets: Private discovery images do not ship in the public website or repository project pack.
